usage.guide: POST to https://gateway.spraay.app/api/v1/notify/sms with JSON {"to":"<E.164 phone>","body":"<message>"}; both fields required. Pay $0.02 USDC via x402 (Base or Solana). Read body.id and body.status ("queued") for the result. IMPORTANT: check body._gateway.live — it is currently false, meaning this is a mock gateway that does NOT actually send the SMS (Twilio/Vonage integration is described as future/production). Treat a 200 as contract-success only, not proof of delivery.
